correctness.rationale: Connected-bipartition classification yields exactly the transversal triples and within-path pairs for every simple theta graph. The all-positive path bound proves Ldim<=3; explicit shattered supports prove all VC lower bounds and the direct-edge obstruction proves VC<=2. A complete eight-leaf house query tree establishes Ldim=3 in the strict-gap case. Counting six hypotheses handles the diamond. A separate universal classification handles trees/unicyclic graphs, and a finite graph-core case split proves six edges is the first and unique minimal threshold. The standalone checker exactly validates both bond enumerations, all house support traces and online depth, nine theta cases, and 595 labeled small connected graphs; no extrapolation supplies an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2021 all-zero-sets equality theorem does not imply the dimensions of the inclusion-maximal subfamily: house hyperplanes have (VC,Ldim)=(2,3), while all zero sets have (3,3). The 2020 bond paper supplies definitions and optimization results, not the exact learning dimensions. Searches for equivalent formulations, dominating theorems and exact small tables found no matching theorem. Historical priority outside accessible primary literature remains a nonzero risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed papers may phrase the same theorem as maximal-zero-set, cocircuit or minimal-cut online learning without explicit theta terminology.
Database hits were mostly semantically adjacent graph-invariant results rather than exact coverage; absence does not certify priority.
The cut-dimension paper was compared via its abstract and invariant definition, not full-text exhaustion; its definition is materially different.

value.rationale: A complete uniform classification for all simple theta graphs identifies exactly when maximal-flat restriction retains online dimension but lowers static VC dimension. An analytic graph-core census identifies a unique six-edge first obstruction, while a general lemma proves equality for all trees and unicyclic graphs. This is a motivated boundary for matroid-hyperplane concept complexity and not merely a small numeric re-tabulation.
